next.reason: X3.23a-1989 only boxed numbered paragraphs 3 and 4 (a typographical correction, erratum C147, kb/Work PB5045); the wording is the printed wording and the level-2 box is no difference. 1985: a program is in the initial state 'The first time the program is called after the execution of a CALL statement referencing a program that possesses the initial attribute, and that directly or indirectly contains the program.' (§1985:X.2.4.2 GR4). 2023: static data is placed in the initial state 'The first time the program in which it is described is activated after the execution of an activating statement referencing a program that possesses the initial attribute and directly or indirectly contains the program' (§2023:14.6.2.3.2 GR2), and 'When an initial program is activated, the data items and file connectors contained in it and any program contained within it are set to their initial states' (§2023:11.10.4 GR3). A program is activated when 'successfully called from a runtime element' (§2023:14.6.2.2), so called to activated is wording. Same requirement.
